18560-chopin-and-other-musical-essays.title: Other Musical Essays
18560-chopin-and-other-musical-essays.creator: Henry T. Finck
18560-chopin-and-other-musical-essays.description: A book by Henry T. Finck. New York told me that he sold three times as many of Chopin's compositions as of any other romantic or classical composer. This seems to indicate that Chopin is popular. Nevertheless, I believe that what Liszt wrote in 1850, a year after the death of Chopin--that his fame was not yet as great as it would be in the future--is as true to-day as it was forty years ago.

arxiv-1912-05856.title: Anomalous Diffusion in Systems with Concentration-Dependent Diffusivity
arxiv-1912-05856.creator: Alex Hansen 1,3,, Eirik G. Flekkøy 2,4,
arxiv-1912-05856.description: Abstract We show analytically that there is anomalous diffusion when the diffusion constant depends on the concentration as a power law with a positive exponent or a negative exponent with absolute value less than one and the initial condition is a delta function in the concentration.

arxiv-2011-01811.title: Fast High Resolution Blood Flow Estimation and Clutter Rejection via an Alternating Optimization Problem
arxiv-2011-01811.creator: Duong-Hung Pham, Adrian Basarab, Jean-Pierre Remenieras, Paul Rodríguez, Denis Kouamé
arxiv-2011-01811.description: Abstract This paper introduces a computationally efficient technique for estimating high-resolution Doppler blood flow from an ultrafast ultrasound image sequence. More precisely, it consists in a new fast alternating minimization algorithm that implements a blind deconvolution method based on robust principal component analysis.

arxiv-2309-08724.title: Merging two Hierarchies of Internal Contextual Grammars with Subregular Selection
arxiv-2309-08724.creator: Bianca Truthe
arxiv-2309-08724.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Bianca Truthe. In this paper, we continue the research on the power of contextual grammars with selection languages from subfamilies of the family of regular languages. In the past, two independent hierarchies have been obtained for external and internal contextual grammars, one based on selection languages defined by structural properties (finite, monoidal, nilpotent, combinational, definite, ordered, non-counting, power-separating, suffix-closed, commutative, circular, or union-free languages), the other one based on selection languages defined by resources (number of non-terminal symbols, production rules, or states needed for

arxiv-2312-07978.title: Electrodynamics and Geometric Continuum Mechanics
arxiv-2312-07978.creator: Reuven Segev
arxiv-2312-07978.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Reuven Segev. This paper offers an informal instructive introduction to some of the main notions of geometric continuum mechanics for the case of smooth fields. We use a metric invariant stress theory of continuum mechanics to formulate a simple generalization of the fields of electrodynamics and Maxwell’s equations to general differentiable manifolds of any dimension, thus viewing generalized electrodynamics as a special case of continuum mechanics.

arxiv-2403-16832.title: Testing for sufficient follow-up in survival data with a cure fraction
arxiv-2403-16832.creator: Tsz Pang Yuen, Eni Musta
arxiv-2403-16832.description: Abstract In order to estimate the proportion of ‘immune’ or ‘cured’ subjects who will never experience failure, a sufficiently long follow-up period is required. Several statistical tests have been proposed in the literature for assessing the assumption of sufficient follow-up, meaning that the study duration is longer than the support of the survival times for the uncured subjects.

arxiv-2409-18102.title: MALPOLON: A Framework for Deep Species Distribution Modeling
arxiv-2409-18102.creator: Theo Larcher, Lukas Picek, Benjamin Deneu, Titouan Lorieul, Maximilien Servajean, Alexis Joly
arxiv-2409-18102.description: Abstract This paper describes a deep-SDM framework, MALPOLON. Written in Python and built upon the PyTorch library, this framework aims to facilitate training and inferences of deep species distribution models (deep-SDM) and sharing for users with only general Python language skills (e.g., modeling ecologists) who are interested in testing deep learning approaches to build new SDMs.

arxiv-2505-06481.title: QoS-Efficient Serving of Multiple Mixture-of-Expert LLMs Using Partial Runtime Reconfiguration
arxiv-2505-06481.creator: HamidReza Imani, Jiaxin Peng, Peiman Mohseni, Abdolah Amirany, Tarek El-Ghazawi
arxiv-2505-06481.description: Abstract The deployment of mixture-of-experts (MoE) large language models (LLMs) presents significant challenges due to their high memory demands. These challenges become even more pronounced in multi-tenant environments, where shared resources must accommodate multiple models, limiting the effectiveness of conventional virtualization techniques. This paper addresses the problem of efficiently serving multiple fine-tuned MoE-LLMs on a single-GPU.

arxiv-2506-10203.title: Formalizing Neuromorphic Control Systems A General Proposal and A Rhythmic Case Study
arxiv-2506-10203.creator: Taisia Medvedeva, Alessio Franci, Fernando Castaños
arxiv-2506-10203.description: Abstract Neuromorphic control is receiving growing attention due to the multifaceted advantages it brings over more classical control approaches, including: sparse and on-demand sensing, information transmission, and actuation; energy efficient designs and realizations in neuromorphic hardware; event-based signal processing and control signal computation.

arxiv-2508-19228.title: Predicting the Order of Upcoming Tokens Improves Language Modeling
arxiv-2508-19228.creator: Zayd M. K. Zuhri, Erland Hilman Fuadi & Alham Fikri Aji
arxiv-2508-19228.description: Abstract Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) has been proposed as an auxiliary objective to improve next-token prediction (NTP) in language model training but shows inconsistent improvements, underperforming in standard NLP benchmarks. We argue that MTP’s exact future token prediction is too difficult as an auxiliary loss.

britannica-1911-stresa.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-stresa.description: Article 'Stresa' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Novara, situated on the west side of Lago Maggiore, on the Simplon railway, 10 m. It is remarkable for the beauty of its scenery and for its fine villas, and is a favourite resort in spring, summer and autumn.

pmc-10737596.title: THE EFFECT OF DUAL-TASKS ON WALKING SPEED IN HEALTHY OLDER ADULTS: A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW AND META-ANALYSIS
pmc-10737596.creator: Hyeon Jung Heselton, Adam Rosen, Julie Blaskewicz Boron
pmc-10737596.description: Normative age-related changes occur in both walking and cognitive performance; non-normative changes could lead to decreased mobility, loss of autonomy in daily life, and increased fall risk. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to assess the effects of completing a dual-task on overground walking speed in healthy older adults.

pmc-11440468.title: Hierarchically Porous Structured Adsorbents with Ultrahigh Metal–Organic Framework Loading for CO2 Capture
pmc-11440468.creator: Solomon
pmc-11440468.description: Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) have emerged as promising candidates for CO2 adsorption due to their ultrahigh-specific surface area and highly tunable pore-surface properties. However, their large-scale application is hindered by processing issues associated with their microcrystalline powder nature, such as dustiness, pressure drop, and poor mass transfer within packed beds.

pmc-11574976.title: Complete mitochondrial genome of freshwater goby Rhinogobius shennongensis (Perciformes, Gobiidae): genome characterization and phylogenetic analysis
pmc-11574976.creator: Xiao Jiang Chen, Lin Song, Xing Peng Han, Quan Wang
pmc-11574976.description: In this study, we present the complete mitochondrial genome of Rhinogobius shennongensis, sequenced using the Illumina HiSeq platform. The result is a circular mitogenome of 16,500 base pairs (bp) with a pronounced A + T nucleotide bias. Phylogenetic analysis was conducted using both Bayesian inference (BI) and maximum-likelihood (ML) methods, utilizing the complete mitochondrial genomes of R.

pmc-11647786.title: Perforating pharyngeal injury caused by minor blunt trauma to the neck: A case report
pmc-11647786.creator: Makoto Kobayashi, Junnosuke Saito, Hiroki Fujino, Kyohei Sakurai, Yoshimatsu Ehama
pmc-11647786.description: BackgroundPharyngeal perforation has been documented as a consequence of substantial external force applied to the neck. Such trauma is frequently accompanied by additional organ injury and cervical fracture. In this report, we present an exceptionally rare instance in which minor blunt trauma to the neck resulted in pharyngeal injury without concomitant damage to other organs.

pmc-11716202.title: The Influence of COVID‐19 and Positive Interactions on Children’s Mental Representations of the Elderly and Dementia: A Drawing‐based Study
pmc-11716202.creator: Kasper Bormans, Sandra Zwakhalen
pmc-11716202.description: BackgroundAmidst the global impact of COVID‐19, this study delves into how restrictions and positive interactions shape children’s mental images of the elderly and dementia. We organized drawing sessions with three groups to investigate the malleability of children’s perceptions, offering crucial insights for future Alzheimer’s research.MethodThis study gathered 848 children’s drawings from 106 ten‐year‐old children in Flanders and the Netherlands.

pmc-12373842.title: 3D collagen high-throughput screen identifies drugs that induce epithelial polarity and enhance chemotherapy response in colorectal cancer
pmc-12373842.creator: Sarah J. Harmych, Thomas P. Hasaka, Chelsie K. Sievers, Seung Woo Kang, Marisol A. Ramirez, Vivian Truong Jones, Zhiguo Zhao, Oleg Kovtun, Claudia C. Wahoski, Qi Liu, Ken S. Lau, Robert J. Coffey, Joshua A. Bauer, Bhuminder Singh
pmc-12373842.description: Loss of polarity is a hallmark of cancer, and the related epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) phenotype impacts prognosis and therapy outcomes, particularly in colorectal cancer (CRC). However, the mechanisms and drugs that impact EMT-related morphological changes are understudied, due to the complete failure of typical live/dead 2D high-throughput screens to capture morphology or the lack of robustness of 3D screens.

pmc-12471290.title: Fe-Cr-Mo-B-Si-C Metamorphic Alloy Coating with Excellent Wear Resistance Fabricated via High-Velocity Oxygen Fuel Thermal Spray Process
pmc-12471290.creator: Yu-Jin Hwang, Yong-Hoon Cho, Gi-Su Ham, Choongnyun Paul Kim, Kee-Ahn Lee, Mehrdad Faraji
pmc-12471290.description: A cost-effective Fe-Cr-Mo-B-Si-C metamorphic alloy (HXA5) was newly designed and fabricated as coating material using the high-velocity oxygen fuel (HVOF) thermal spray process, and its microstructure and dry wear resistance were investigated in comparison with a conventional HVOF WC-12Co coating. The HXA5 coating material consisted of a splat area and un-melted powder area.

pmc-12561999.title: Ferroptosis: The Initiation Process of Lipid Peroxidation in Muscle Food
pmc-12561999.creator: Joseph Kanner, Adi Shpaizer, Oren Tirosh, Giancarlo Aldini
pmc-12561999.description: Animal slaughtering causes the cessation of oxygen delivery and that of nutrients such as cystine, glucose and others to muscle cells. In muscle cells, the changes in oxygen level and pH cause mitochondria, the endoplasmic reticulum, xanthine oxidase and uncoupled NOS to increase the level of O2•−, affecting the generation of H2O2 and the release of iron ions from ferritin.

pmc-12948613.title: Robotic-assisted esophageal endoscopic submucosal dissection in a compact and extensive early Barrett’s cancer lesion
pmc-12948613.creator: Giorgi Tvaradze, Mayo Tanabe, Kazuki Yamamoto, Stefan Groth, Ewerton Marques Maggio, Haruhiro Inoue, Stefan Seewald
pmc-12948613.description: field. This loss of visualization and traction limitation makes dissection challenging. Conventional traction methods provide only limited axis movements and cannot be easily repositioned 3 4 . A novel EndoRobotics Alligator (ROBOPERA & TraCloser) device is designed for flexible multipoint traction. The device provides true four-axis independent movements, enabling multidirectional traction 5 .

pmc-12979271.title: Targeting amino acid metabolic pathways: a novel therapeutic strategy for hyperuricemia-associated complications
pmc-12979271.creator: Xinya Zhang, Wenkai Wang, Le Yang, Ye Sun, Hui Sun, Xueping Zhao, Hui Sun, Guangli Yan, Xijun Wang
pmc-12979271.description: Hyperuricemia (HUA) is a metabolic disorder that contributes to the pathogenesis of gout arthritis (GA), chronic kidney disease (CKD), and cardiovascular disease (CVD). While current urate-lowering therapies effectively reduce serum uric acid levels, they fail to address the underlying metabolic dysregulation driving HUA progression and associated tissue damage.

pmc-13585093.title: Training a force field for proteins and small molecules from scratch
pmc-13585093.creator: Alexandre Blanco-González, Thea K. Schulze, Evianne Rovers, Joe G. Greener
pmc-13585093.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Force fields for molecular dynamics are usually developed manually, limiting their transferability and making systematic exploration of functional forms challenging. We developed a graph neural network that assigns all force field parameters for diverse molecules using continuous atom typing. The freely-available model, called Garnet, was trained on quantum mechanical, condensed phase and protein nuclear magnetic resonance data without the use of existing parameters.
